# Acceptance Criteria

## Visual gates

- [ ] Three materially different routes rendered at mobile and desktop
- [ ] One route selected
- [ ] Hero + proof prototype passed visual judge at >= 8.0, no category below 7
- [ ] One signature experience implemented
- [ ] Final page passed blind visual judge
- [ ] Real project evidence used or remaining placeholders explicitly block launch

## Narrative and conversion

- [ ] First screen explains offer, audience/value, proof, and action
- [ ] Each section adds a new fact, proof point, or action
- [ ] Editorial pass removed repeated positioning and internal prompt language
- [ ] Primary conversion works

## Technical

- [ ] Responsive widths tested
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, semantics, and form states tested
- [ ] Reduced motion tested
- [ ] Console and network checked
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests, and production build pass
